lessons.title: Story Time: Moving Up a Class
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to discuss a character's feelings about change.
success_criteria: I can say how the character felt about moving up.
I can find a clue that tells me.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss feelings about moving to Year 2.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a story about a character moving up a class/school year, modelling discussion of feelings.
lessons.independent_task: Children discuss and record how the character felt, and how they feel about Year 2.
resources_needed: Story book about starting a new class/year
key_questions: How did the character feel?
How do you feel about Year 2?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension and personal connection to the transition theme — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.plenary: Recap feelings about moving up a class.
lessons.home_link: Talk about how you feel about Year 2 with your family.

lessons.title: Number Recap: Counting and Place Value
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate secure counting and place value understanding ready for Year 2.
success_criteria: I can count confidently to 20 and beyond.
I can represent numbers using tens and ones.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap counting and place value from the year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate counting and place value skills, discussing what comes next in Year 2 (numbers to 100).
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a counting and place value consolidation activity.
key_questions: How many tens and ones make this number?
Can you count confidently to 30?
lessons.assessment_notes: Final Year 1 number consolidation check, preparing for Year 2 — evidence for MATHS.N1.
lessons.plenary: Recap readiness for Year 2 number work.
lessons.home_link: Practise counting and place value together.

lessons.title: Writing a Letter to My Year 2 Self
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write a short letter with advice or hopes for Year 2.
success_criteria: I can write a sentence of advice or hope.
I can use a capital letter and full stop.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what advice they might give their future Year 2 self.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing a short letter with a piece of advice or a hope for Year 2.
lessons.independent_task: Children write their own letter to their Year 2 self.
key_questions: What advice would you give?
What are you looking forward to?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective writing and sentence construction — evidence for ENG.W2/W3.
lessons.home_link: Read your letter to your family.

lessons.title: Addition and Subtraction: Final Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate secure addition and subtraction skills ready for Year 2.
success_criteria: I can add within 20 confidently.
I can subtract within 20 confidently.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap addition and subtraction strategies from the year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate addition and subtraction skills, discussing progression to numbers within 100 in Year 2.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete an addition and subtraction consolidation activity.
key_questions: What strategy will you use?
Can you solve this without counters?
lessons.assessment_notes: Final Year 1 addition/subtraction consolidation check — evidence for MATHS.N2.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate progress made in addition and subtraction this year.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising addition and subtraction over the summer.

lessons.title: Phonics: Year 1 Sounds Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read words using the full range of Phase 5 sounds learned this year.
success_criteria: I can blend and read a range of words.
I can read a short passage.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the full range of graphemes learned this year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate reading using a mixed range of graphemes learned throughout Year 1.
lessons.independent_task: Children read a short mixed passage, demonstrating fluency across the year's phonics learning.
key_questions: Can you read this word?
Can you read this passage fluently?

differentiation.support: Read with support, focusing on core sounds

lessons.assessment_notes: End of Year 1 phonics consolidation check, informing Year 2 planning — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading together over the summer.

lessons.title: Shape and Position Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate secure shape and position knowledge ready for Year 2.
success_criteria: I can name 2D and 3D shapes confidently.
I can describe position and direction.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap shape and position vocabulary from the year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate shape and position skills, discussing what's next in Year 2 (more complex shapes, right angles).
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a shape and position consolidation activity.
key_questions: What shape is this?
Can you describe this position?

differentiation.greater_depth: Extend to less common shapes and combined directions

lessons.assessment_notes: Final Year 1 shape/position consolidation check — evidence for MATHS.GEO.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate progress made in shape and position this year.
lessons.home_link: Continue spotting shapes and giving directions over the summer.

lessons.title: Meeting Our Year 2 Teacher
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to prepare and ask a question to their new teacher.
success_criteria: I can think of a question to ask.
I can ask it clearly.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what children might want to know about Year 2.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model preparing a clear, polite question to ask a new teacher.
lessons.independent_task: Children prepare a question for their Year 2 teacher (real transition visit if scheduled, or role-play).
resources_needed: None required, or transition visit schedule
key_questions: What would you like to know about Year 2?
How will you ask your question clearly?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language and preparation for transition — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.home_link: Think of one more question about Year 2 with your family.

lessons.title: Fractions and Sharing: Final Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate secure fraction and sharing skills ready for Year 2.
success_criteria: I can find half and a quarter confidently.
I can share and group fairly.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap fractions and sharing from the year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate fraction and sharing skills, discussing progression to thirds and more complex fractions in Year 2.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a fractions and sharing consolidation activity.
key_questions: What is half/a quarter of this?
How would you share this fairly?

differentiation.greater_depth: Solve without concrete resources where possible

lessons.assessment_notes: Final Year 1 fractions/sharing consolidation check — evidence for MATHS.N3/N4.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate progress made in fractions this year.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising fractions over the summer.

lessons.title: Reflecting on My Year 1 Reading Journey
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to reflect on their reading progress across Year 1.
success_criteria: I can say what I could read at the start of the year.
I can say what I can read now.
lessons.starter_activity: Look back at reading samples/records from earlier in the year if available.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss reflecting on reading progress made across the year.
lessons.independent_task: Children reflect on and record their reading progress this year.
resources_needed: Reading records/samples from the year if available
key_questions: What could you read at the start of the year?
What can you read now?

differentiation.greater_depth: Give detailed reflection on specific progress

lessons.assessment_notes: Note self-awareness of reading progress across Year 1 — evidence for ENG.R1/R2.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate everyone's reading progress this year.
lessons.home_link: Read your favourite book from this year with your family.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Full Year 1 Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply the full range of maths skills learned across Year 1.
success_criteria: I can count, add, subtract, measure and identify shapes confidently.
I can explain my strategies.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key vocabulary from the whole year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of the year's core maths content across all areas.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a comprehensive mixed review covering the year's key maths skills.
key_questions: What strategy will you use?
Can you explain how you solved this?

differentiation.support: Complete with reduced complexity and support

lessons.assessment_notes: Final Year 1 maths consolidation summary for each child, informing Year 2 starting points.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate a whole year of maths learning.
lessons.home_link: Review the year's maths learning together over the summer.
